description: Apertus2 Megachonk: 61 layers, 256 routed experts (8 per token), 16 KV heads, about 1.1 TB in BF16, so 8 nodes at least. Base model: no chat template, reasoning or tool parser. Its config sets 8,192 positions; the #67 launcher raises them to the context length, as here. Its weights take 75.6 GiB per GPU in TP2 x DP16 (EP32): at the platform's 0.88 GPU memory share only 1.87 GiB was left for KV, less than one 32,768-token request (job 5445600), so it uses 0.90. 0.95 (the #67 launcher's value) left too little for CUDA graphs and autotuning in the TP4 x PP4 and TP4 x PP8 layouts, which ran out of GPU memory after the KV cache was set aside (jobs 5446265, 5446266).
